The digital laboratory brings together open developments published on GitHub and educational resources from the laboratory.

::: {.resource-grid}
::: {.resource-item}
## Chemistry models in augmented reality

**Repository:** `quimica-ar`  
**What it is:** three-dimensional visualization and augmented reality of molecular models of carboxylic acids, in collaboration with LabTec and UMCE.  
**Educational use:** spatial observation and representation of chemical structures.

[Try the application](https://lab-macedonia.github.io/quimica-ar/) · [Source code](https://github.com/lab-macedonia/quimica-ar)
:::
::: {.resource-item}
## Interactive science simulations

**Repository:** `simulaciones-quimica`  
**What it is:** a collection of 115 interactive simulations in chemistry, biology, earth sciences and physics, related to learning objectives of the Chilean school curriculum.  
**License:** MIT.  
**Teacher guides:** one per simulation, with learning objectives, a classroom activity, a question bank and an answer key.  
**Curriculum:** each simulation is mapped to the Chilean Ministry of Education's learning objectives.  
**Educational use:** interactive exploration of scientific phenomena.

[Explore the simulations](https://lab-macedonia.github.io/simulaciones-quimica/simulaciones/index.en.html) · [Teacher guides](https://lab-macedonia.github.io/simulaciones-quimica/simulaciones/guias/en/index.html) · [Curriculum coverage](https://lab-macedonia.github.io/simulaciones-quimica/simulaciones/curriculo.en.html) · [Source code](https://github.com/lab-macedonia/simulaciones-quimica)
:::
::: {.resource-item}
## Organic chemistry animations

**Topics:** stereochemistry, isomerism, Newman and sawhorse projections, and molecular conformations.  
**Origin:** developed in the thesis of Mauricio Cortés and published under a **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0** license.  
**Availability:** 25 animations under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

[Watch the animations](animations.qmd)
:::
:::

## How to use these resources

1. Identify the resource and its learning objectives.
2. Review the instructions and terms of use in the corresponding repository.
3. Integrate the activity with questions, discussion and formative assessment.
4. Check licenses and attributions before redistributing materials.
